name: splash court: special-move cards render in the inline feed tile, positioned in screen space, and the play rotation unlocks SET PICK!
description: SHOW_MOVE_CARDS in SplashCourt.jsx mounts the shared SpecialMoveCards set (the same seven the real game raises - table lives in components/SpecialMoveCards.jsx so the feed tile and the match cannot drift). Three things are checked. (1) CARDS APPEAR AT ALL: poll for any [data-testid^='special-card-'] node during the attract loop. (2) SCREEN SPACE: GameScene shifts its viewBox by cameraX so it passes cameraX to cancel it; SplashCourt instead translates the FIELD by -cameraX inside a fixed viewBox, so its cards must sit outside the field group with cameraX=0. If that were wrong the card would be double-panned off screen, so the outer transform must be exactly translate(0, 0) and the card box must be centred on SPLASH_CARD_CY (120), not the in-game default 74. (3) SET PICK! REQUIRES THE PLAY ROTATION: isPicking is set only by triggerPickAndRoll, which useGame reaches only when play?.id === 'pickroll'. The splash used to answer onPickPlay(null), which falls through to motion offence, so that card was unreachable; AUTO_PLAY='rotate' cycles the real PLAYS table. Seeing special-card-pick proves the rotation is landing. Runs in App Desktop/Mobile via App.jsx's DEV-only ?mode=inline override, because Post View is not a WebContentsView and the runner cannot attach to it.

steps._comment: Mounts the same inline branch (SplashCourt) inside a normal webview. Cache-busting t= forces a fresh module load and therefore a fresh ability roll.
ATTRACT='static' has no sim, so every assertion below would be vacuous.

steps.until: (() => { window.__cards = window.__cards || {}; window.__geom = window.__geom || {}; const ns = [...document.querySelectorAll("[data-testid^='special-card-']")]; ns.forEach(n => { const k = n.getAttribute('data-testid'); window.__cards[k] = (window.__cards[k] || 0) + 1; if (!window.__geom[k]) { let b = null; try { b = n.getBBox(); } catch (e) {} window.__geom[k] = { tf: n.getAttribute('transform'), cx: b ? Math.round(b.x + b.width / 2) : null, cy: b ? Math.round(b.y + b.height / 2) : null }; } }); return ns.length > 0; })()
steps._comment: Poll every 200ms, accumulating every card testid seen plus the geometry of the first sighting of each. Exits the instant a card is actually on screen so the next step can photograph it.
Taken immediately after the loop exits, while a card is still up (a card lives 1-3s).

steps.expression: (() => { document.querySelectorAll('#probe-card-seen,#probe-card-screenspace').forEach(n => n.remove()); const seen = Object.keys(window.__cards || {}); const g = window.__geom || {}; const mk = id => { const d = document.createElement('div'); d.id = id; document.body.appendChild(d); }; if (seen.length > 0) mk('probe-card-seen'); const bad = seen.filter(k => { const e = g[k]; if (!e) return true; const tfOk = /translate\(\s*0\s*,\s*0\s*\)/.test(e.tf || ''); const cyOk = e.cy !== null && e.cy >= 100 && e.cy <= 140; const cxOk = e.cx !== null && e.cx >= 184 && e.cx <= 224; return !(tfOk && cyOk && cxOk); }); if (seen.length > 0 && bad.length === 0) mk('probe-card-screenspace'); return JSON.stringify({ seen, bad, geom: g }); })()

steps._comment: ASSERTION 1: at least one special-move card rendered in the inline splash.

ASSERTION 2: every card seen had transform translate(0, 0) (cameraX not double-applied) and its box centred on x=204 +/-20, y=120 +/-20 - i.e. SPLASH_CARD_CY, not the in-game 74 that would collide with the title.

steps.until: (() => { window.__cards = window.__cards || {}; document.querySelectorAll("[data-testid^='special-card-']").forEach(n => { const k = n.getAttribute('data-testid'); window.__cards[k] = (window.__cards[k] || 0) + 1; }); document.querySelectorAll("[data-testid^='splash-player-']").forEach(n => { const a = n.getAttribute('data-anim') || 'idle'; window.__anims = window.__anims || {}; window.__anims[a] = (window.__anims[a] || 0) + 1; }); return !!window.__cards['special-card-pick']; })()
steps._comment: Keep sampling until the SET PICK! card shows. pickroll is every third home possession under AUTO_PLAY='rotate', so this needs a couple of possessions.
Which cards fired and how the animation mix looked - shows what the feed tile actually renders.

steps.expression: (() => { document.querySelectorAll('#probe-pick-card,#probe-card-variety').forEach(n => n.remove()); const c = window.__cards || {}; const mk = id => { const d = document.createElement('div'); d.id = id; document.body.appendChild(d); }; if (c['special-card-pick']) mk('probe-pick-card'); if (Object.keys(c).length >= 2) mk('probe-card-variety'); return JSON.stringify({ cards: Object.keys(c) }); })()

steps._comment: ASSERTION 3: SET PICK! appeared. Impossible with the old onPickPlay(null) wiring, so this specifically proves AUTO_PLAY='rotate' is feeding real plays into the loop.
ASSERTION 4: at least two DIFFERENT cards fired, so this is not one lucky animation on repeat.

steps.expression: (() => { document.querySelectorAll('#probe-card-seen,#probe-card-screenspace,#probe-pick-card,#probe-card-variety').forEach(n => n.remove()); delete window.__cards; delete window.__geom; delete window.__anims; return 'cleaned'; })()

steps._comment: The query string survives reloads, so leaving it set would silently boot later app-view tests into the splash.
